common.askSave: You have unsaved changes. Save them before closing?
home.installDesc: Once installed, the Play button on roblox.com opens Roblox through SenStrap. No administrator rights needed.
home.installed: SenStrap installed. You can now play from roblox.com
home.quickMods: Death sound, cursors and your own files.
home.quickHistory: Jump back into your recent games.
home.safe: SenStrap downloads the official Roblox client from Roblox's servers. It doesn't modify the game.
history.title: History
history.subtitle: Your recent games. Rejoin with one click.
history.empty: No games yet. Turn on activity tracking in Integrations and play something.
launcher.title: Launcher
launcher.subtitle: What SenStrap does when it opens Roblox.
launcher.confirm: Ask if Roblox is already open
launcher.confirmDesc: Stops you from closing your current game by opening another one by accident.
launcher.confirmPrompt:
Roblox is already open. If you continue, that game will close.

Continue?
launcher.crashDesc: Closes RobloxCrashHandler.exe when the game opens to save resources.
launcher.cleanerWhenDesc: Files older than this are deleted when Roblox opens.
launcher.cleanDownloadsDesc: Roblox packages that are no longer used.
launcher.cleanRobloxLogsDesc: The logs Roblox saves for every game.
integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.subtitle: For these, SenStrap stays in the system tray while you play and reads Roblox's logs.
integrations.trackingDesc: Detects which game and server you join. The options below need it.
integrations.locationDesc: Tells you where your server is when you join. Looks up the server IP on ipinfo.io.
integrations.playtimeDesc: Counts your total and per-session playtime.
integrations.historyDesc: Saves the games you join so you can rejoin them.
flags.title: FastFlags
flags.subtitle: Roblox's internal settings. Use quick settings or the editor.
flags.allowlist: Roblox only accepts FastFlags on its allowlist. It ignores the ones marked with ⚠.
flags.msaaDesc: Smooths jagged edges. Higher looks better but costs performance.
flags.voxelDesc: Removes baked shadows. Faster, but some games look flatter.
flags.graySkyDesc: Replaces the sky with plain gray (not in games with their own sky).
flags.meshDesc: How far away objects keep their full detail.
flags.dpiDesc: Stops Roblox from lowering its resolution when Windows uses scaling.
flags.altEnterDesc: With Direct3D 11, Alt+Enter switches to exclusive fullscreen.
flags.levelDesc: Roblox's graphics slider will only change view distance.
flags.name: Flag name
flags.empty: No flags. Add one or import a JSON.
mods.title: Mods
mods.subtitle: Swap Roblox files for your own. Applied the next time you open the game.
mods.openFolderDesc: Drop your files using Roblox's folder layout.
mods.removeAllDesc: Roblox goes back to the original.
mods.deathDesc: Replace the sound your character makes when it dies with your own .ogg.
mods.cursorDesc: Use your own .png image as the cursor (64×64 works best).
mods.shiftlockDesc: Use your own .png image for the Shift Lock cursor.
mods.customActive: Custom. Applied the next time you open Roblox.
mods.none: You don't have any mods yet.
mods.noneToRemove: You don't have any mods to remove
appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.subtitle: Give SenStrap your style. Changes show instantly.
appearance.previewDesc: Opens a demo of the window you see when you press Play. Doesn't open Roblox.
settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Language and maintenance for SenStrap and its copy of Roblox.
settings.reinstallDesc: Deletes SenStrap's copy of Roblox. It downloads again the next time you play.
settings.reinstalled: Roblox will be reinstalled the next time you play
settings.logsDesc: What SenStrap has done. Useful if something fails.
settings.uninstallDesc: Play buttons go back to the launcher you used before (Froststrap, Bloxstrap or the official one).
settings.about: Alternative Roblox launcher. It doesn't modify the game: it downloads the official client and opens it with your settings.
uninstall.confirm:
Uninstall SenStrap?

Its copy of Roblox, your FastFlags and your mods will be deleted.
boot.hint: Official Roblox client, straight from its servers
status.demo: Opening Roblox… (just a demo, nothing opens)
welcome.title: Welcome to SenStrap!
welcome.subtitle: Choose your language
launcher.bgUpdatesDesc: If there's a new version, Roblox opens right away with the one you have and the new one downloads while you play. Not for slow connections.
integrations.autoRejoinDesc: If you lose connection to the server, SenStrap closes the disconnected Roblox and rejoins the same server. Never after a kick or ban.
notify.rejoinGaveUp: Too many disconnections in a row. Automatic rejoin paused for a while.
home.quickOptimizations: Windows and Roblox tweaks you can undo.
appearance.snowLauncherDesc: Also shows the snow while Roblox opens.
appearance.introDesc: Shows the logo for a moment when SenStrap opens. Click to skip it.
opt.title: Optimizations
opt.subtitle: Tweaks for Windows and Roblox. SenStrap saves how everything was, so every change can be undone.
opt.uacDenied: Administrator permission was denied, so system-wide changes weren't made.
opt.cleaned: Done. There was nothing to delete
opt.noticeRestart: Some changes finish applying after you restart your PC.
opt.noticeSignOut: Some changes apply the next time you sign in to Windows.
opt.noticeExplorer: Some changes show up after restarting File Explorer.
opt.confirmExplorer: File Explorer and the taskbar will close and open again. Open folders will close. Continue?
opt.allRecommended: All recommended optimizations are already on
opt.confirmRecommended: Turn on {0} recommended optimizations? You can undo them at any time.
opt.adminNote: Windows will ask once for administrator permission for the system-wide ones.
opt.confirmRevert: Undo the {0} optimizations SenStrap applied and put everything back as it was?
credits.title: Credits
credits.subtitle: Who makes SenStrap.
credits.repoDesc: Source code, releases and changes on GitHub.
credits.issuesDesc: Found a bug or have an idea? Open an issue on GitHub.
credits.licenseDesc: Free to use, change and share, keeping the copyright notice.
credits.thanksInspired: Inspired by Bloxstrap, Fishstrap and Froststrap.
credits.thanksData: Game names and icons come from Roblox's public APIs; server locations from ipinfo.io.
credits.thanksDiscord: The profile picture comes from Discord through japi.rest.
credits.disclaimer: SenStrap is not affiliated with Roblox Corporation. Roblox is a trademark of Roblox Corporation.
update.failed: Couldn't update SenStrap. This version will open instead.
update.hint: Your settings, mods and Roblox stay as they are
settings.autoUpdateDesc: When it opens, SenStrap checks GitHub for a new version and installs it. Only SenStrap is replaced: your settings and Roblox stay.
